Name: Ghoulish Monster Loot
Author: herbivoor
Description:
[center][size=3][font=Georgia]It may not be October, but it's time to get ~spooky~! [color=#f9cb9c](㇏(•̀ᵥᵥ•́)ノ)[/color][/font]

[font=Georgia][img]https://i.imgur.com/HLOfFPU.png[/img]﻿[/font]

[font=Georgia]I feel like the game's monster loot doesn't get enough love, so here's a lil mod to fix that!
This mod is a replaces the textures of the bug meat, bug steak, solar essence, void essence, slime, and bat wing.

I've included a couple of config options; one to change the bug meat to blue from the vanilla-style pink for a more insectoid vibe; and one to give you some slime colors to choose from, including a seasonal option. You can see previews in the images section and a gif of the seasonal slime option below. Just type the options into the config.json as they are in the preview images or configure with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.
[/font]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Xb0EVcd.gif[/img]﻿﻿

[/size][/font][u][font=Georgia][size=3]Compatibility[/size][/font][/u][/center][font=Georgia][size=3][center]
Replaces each sprite individually NOT the whole tilesheet, so should be compatible with just about everything!
However, the patch method used is edit rather than overlay, so it should override any other mods attempting to replace the same textures.

If you want to use a different mod for some of the textures (or just prefer how the vanilla versions look), you can disable each one individually in the config. 

﻿- [color=#b4a7d6]༼ つ ❍_❍ ༽つ[/color] -

[u]Installation[/u]

You can find a complete basics guide to installing mods [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]here[/url]﻿. For the vast majority of mods (including all of mine), simply follow that guide and then extract the .rar or .zip file provided by the modder into your Mods folder using a program like winzip, 7zip, or winrar.
